question.instructions: Assess Gemini CLI maintainer priority from title, body, labels, and comments. Let substantive technical findings establish affected behavior over title framing. Judge impact, persistence, recovery, compatibility, and safety; assess effort separately. Accept reported impact with sparse details. Apply category-specific severity before considering workarounds. For genuine ambiguity, especially P2/P3, retain an existing priority. Distinguish unclear integration/workflow inquiries from simple usage questions and content-only feedback. Refactors inherit behavioral impact.

criteria.priority/p1: Severe core tool, file, config, authentication, or agent-reliability failures; persistent hangs, rapid OOM, unsafe behavior, or launch/security blockers. Required release publishing, verification, and maintenance automation failures, including nightly pipelines, qualify even with workarounds.
criteria.priority/p2: Bounded workflow bugs with restart/reset recovery, terminal UI faults, minor config discovery defects, or confusing errors. Unclear integration, access, or operational inquiries fit here when functional intent is apparent. Retain existing P2 for ambiguous reports with sparse context.
criteria.priority/p3: Trivial bugs, typos, documentation and simple usage questions, cosmetic polish, convenience features, and optional enhancements preserving usable workflows and config compatibility. Content-only website feedback, placeholders, and symbolic text with unspecified functional impact fit here.

seed_question.instructions: How urgent is this GitHub issue for the Gemini CLI maintainers? Judge its impact.

criteria.priority/p1: Critical but workable, or worse: severe issues without a reasonable workaround that significantly degrade the developer experience, e.g. specific tools failing consistently (web_search returns 500s), persistent PTY streaming hangs, memory leaks leading to OOM after short use; also critical failures breaking core functionality.
criteria.priority/p2: Significant issues: affect some workflows but a clear workaround exists, or non-critical bugs, e.g. theme flickering, confusing error messages, minor UI misalignment, failing to read deeply nested config files.
criteria.priority/p3: Minor or enhancements: trivial bugs, typos, documentation requests, or feature requests.
